# Game temporal region

A game occupies an interval bounded by temporal instants that are designated by timestamp information.

This view shows the ontology pattern without MLB JSON paths or RML machinery.

flowchart LR
    N01["Baseball Game"]
    N02["Baseball Event Temporal Instant"]
    N03["Baseball Event Temporal Instant"]
    N04["Baseball Game Temporal Interval"]
    N05["Baseball Timestamp ICE"]

    N04 -->|has last instant| N02
